Instructions for Use
Device description: The Kestrel Coronary Stent System is a coronary stent. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Kestrel Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5T and 3T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial field gradient of 2000 gauss/cm.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- whole body SAR not to exceed 0.4 W/kg.
3 T scanning conditions:
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
